system.description:
You make contact with an unknown Arcanum and bind it to your soul. This Arcanum must be something you design together with the rest of the group; as long as you live, no one else in your world will be able to bind that Arcanum.

Once per scene while you are merged with an Arcanum, you may use an action and spend 2 Fabula Points to trigger that Arcanum's dismiss effect (if any) without dismissing them. Doing so does not trigger the Arcane Circle Skill.

You Spend: @LOSS[2 fp]

GM-gated: not available at character creation.
